messages:
Mira Patel: Quick note: compact-quant run on staging shows embedding drift vs fp16. Near-duplicates dropped from dedupe set.
Jorge Alvarez: Likely numeric jitter from quant kernels. Did we change embedding head post-quantize?
Mira Patel: no model head change, just qcompact compile flags. NN example: fp16 pair cosine 0.91 -> qcompact 0.64.
Sam O'Connor: For golden construction we should union dedupe sets from both models, not rely on a single embedding space.
Keiko Tanaka: Agreed. Label ops will freeze a mini-golden of 40 anchors unioned from fp16+qcompact. label-bot, queue them please.
label-bot: queued 40 items to /labeler/mini-golden/union-dedupe (priority: high). ETA ~6h.
Mira Patel: I'll collect failing ids and attach token dumps + embeddings for both models.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll try recompiling with alternative kernel order to see if embed manifold stabilizes. If stable, re-gen embeddings and re-run dedupe.
Sam O'Connor: Canary plan: deploy 1% to qcompact, monitor span-F1/regressions, auto-fallback to fp16 if >5% regression. Ops, command below.
Jorge Alvarez: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy --model qcompact --route /qa --traffic 1% --fallback fp16-baseline --alert 5%
```
OpsBot: deploy request accepted for qcompact to /qa at 1% traffic; alerts on regression >5%.
Keiko Tanaka: labelers assigned, will tag each anchor with failure_type and adjudicated_answer. Will post results here.
Mira Patel: once adjudicated we update golden and re-run full qcompact eval (dedupe union, latency, token-accuracy). If green, increase to 10%.
Sam O'Connor: I'll add --dedupe-mode union-fp16-qcompact to eval harness and push diffs to the issue.
Mira Patel: opening issue and attaching artifacts: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood-inference/ops/issues/2490
Keiko Tanaka: will update thread with label pass. :thumbsup:
